paper.title_en: Who Writes the Gravitational Second Law of Thermodynamics?
paper.abstract_en: We define gravitational entropy as the manifestly integrable surface charge associated with local transverse Lorentz boosts, entirely bypassing the conventional reliance on spacetime diffeomorphisms. Any notion of entropy must satisfy the second law. To answer the question posed in the title, an analogy with Newtonian classical mechanics is instructive: Newton's second law of motion is written by inertial observers who are defined by the first law of mechanics. We show that the second law of gravitational thermodynamics is written by free-fall observers with path parameterization in which the non-affinity of the geodesics is equal to the expansion of their velocity vector field. We then provide a proof of the local second law by studying variations in entropy as viewed by this class of covariantly-defined causal free-fall observers. We show that the entropy variation is strictly non-decreasing, provided the matter sector satisfies the integrated strong energy condition along the observer path.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 本文重新定义了引力熵，并给出了局部第二定律的证明，与黑洞热力学和广义相对论基础相关。
decision.title_zh: 谁写下了引力的热力学第二定律？
decision.abstract_zh: 我们将引力熵定义为与局部横向洛伦兹提升相关的可显式积分的表面电荷，完全绕过了对时空微分同胚的传统依赖。任何熵的概念都必须满足第二定律。为了回答标题中提出的问题，与牛顿经典力学的类比是有启发性的：牛顿第二运动定律是由惯性观察者写下的，这些观察者由力学第一定律定义。我们表明，引力热力学第二定律是由自由落体观察者写下的，其路径参数化中测地线的非仿射性等于其速度矢量场的膨胀。然后，我们通过研究这类协变定义的因果自由落体观察者所看到的熵的变化，给出了局部第二定律的证明。我们表明，只要物质扇区满足沿观察者路径的积分强能量条件，熵的变化就是严格非递减的。
